prores_intermediates.format: ProRes 422 HQ, yuv422p10le, 1080x1920, 30/1, 360 frames (counted), duration 12.000000 s, BT.2020 / ARIB STD-B67 (HLG) / bt2020nc tags, PCM s24le 48 kHz stereo

audio_pcm.method: decoded pcm_s32le of A, B and V13 master atrim samples [96000,672000)

visual_measurements.conclusion: zoom, top anchor and window shifts rendered as designed; A and B measurably and visibly different

visual_inspection_own.edges: no black/missing borders seen on boundary frames
visual_inspection_own.headroom: hair top stays in frame; tightest around B 179-181

review_mp4.encode: libx265 Main10 CRF16 preset slow, yuv420p10le (4:2:2->4:2:0 chroma subsampling only), HLG/BT.2020 tags passed through, no tone mapping or colour conversion, hvc1 tag; AAC 256 kb/s 48 kHz

review_mp4.aac_vs_pcm: lossy (not bit-identical); cross-correlation lag 0 samples at 8 kHz resolution, equal length

persistence.readback: Drive API listing: both files present with exact byte sizes; SHA256 equal when read back through the Drive mount; no server-side hash compared

not_proven: lip sync by human viewing (audio bit-identical to V13 and source offsets unchanged by readback, but no human sync review)
